setting.Title: AMP-III alarm activations per area and hour
setting.Query:
WITH w0 AS (SELECT DATEADD(hour, 1 + DATEDIFF(hour, 0, COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(datetime, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM('@End')), ''), 120), GETDATE())), 0) AS NowTs,
 DATEADD(hour, DATEDIFF(hour, 0, TRY_CONVERT(datetime, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM('@Start')), ''), 120)), 0) AS S1),
w1 AS (SELECT NowTs, CASE WHEN S1 IS NULL OR S1 >= NowTs THEN DATEADD(hour, -24, NowTs) WHEN S1 < DATEADD(day, -31, NowTs) THEN DATEADD(day, -31, NowTs) ELSE S1 END AS StartTs FROM w0),
w AS (SELECT NowTs, StartTs, CAST(CAST(StartTs AS date) AS datetime) AS D0 FROM w1),
h0 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(hour, w.StartTs, w.NowTs) > 168 THEN DATEADD(hour, -168, w.NowTs) ELSE w.StartTs END AS HStart, w.NowTs FROM w),
hrs AS (SELECT TOP (168) ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) - 1 AS HourNo FROM sys.all_objects),
grp AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES (0,'Reformer (27C10)'),(1,'CO Removal (27C30)'),(2,'Ammonia Loops (27C50)'),(3,'Refrigeration (27C60)'),(4,'ARU/HRU (27C70)'),(5,'BFW (27C80)'),(6,'Flare (27C90)'),(7,'Utilities'),(8,'Common'),(9,'Unassigned')) v(Area, Area_name)),
cnt AS (SELECT DATEDIFF(hour, h0.HStart, t.[TimeStamp]) AS HourNo, ga.Area, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM dbo.[_MaadenAMP3_DCS_ProcessAlarmsAMP3_2] t WITH (NOLOCK) CROSS JOIN h0 CROSS APPLY (SELECT CASE WHEN LEFT(t.[Source], 5) = '27C10' THEN 0 WHEN LEFT(t.[Source], 5) = '27C30' THEN 1 WHEN LEFT(t.[Source], 5) = '27C50' THEN 2 WHEN LEFT(t.[Source], 5) = '27C60' THEN 3 WHEN LEFT(t.[Source], 5) = '27C70' THEN 4 WHEN LEFT(t.[Source], 5) = '27C80' THEN 5 WHEN LEFT(t.[Source], 5) = '27C90' THEN 6 WHEN LEFT(t.[Source], 5) IN ('27000','27100','27110','27120','27130','27140','27150','27210','27220','27900','279AC','279EA','279EE','279FF','279FS','279LA','279PF','279PG','279PH','279PJ','279WJ') THEN 7 WHEN LEFT(t.[Source], 5) IN ('27C00','27CFF','27CPD','27SCA') THEN 8 ELSE 9 END AS Area) ga
WHERE t.[TimeStamp] >= h0.HStart AND t.[TimeStamp] < h0.NowTs AND t.[Condition] <> '' AND t.[ActiveState] = 'ACTIVE' AND t.[AckRequired] = 'ACKREQD' AND ISNULL(t.[Priority], '') <> 'Logging'
GROUP BY DATEDIFF(hour, h0.HStart, t.[TimeStamp]), ga.Area)
SELECT DAY(DATEADD(hour, h.HourNo, h0.HStart)) * 100 + DATEPART(hour, DATEADD(hour, h.HourNo, h0.HStart)) AS [Hour],
g.Area, ISNULL(c.n, 0) AS Activations,
CONVERT(char(16), DATEADD(hour, h.HourNo, h0.HStart), 120) AS Hour_start, g.Area_name
FROM hrs h CROSS JOIN h0 CROSS JOIN grp g
LEFT HASH JOIN cnt c ON c.HourNo = h.HourNo AND c.Area = g.Area
WHERE DATEADD(hour, h.HourNo, h0.HStart) < h0.NowTs
ORDER BY h.HourNo, g.Area

setting.Query:
WITH p AS (SELECT TRY_CONVERT(datetime, NULLIF('@HourStart', ''), 120) AS Hs)
SELECT LEFT(t.[Source], 5) AS Area_code, COUNT(*) AS Activations, COUNT(DISTINCT t.[Source]) AS Tags
FROM dbo.[_MaadenAMP3_DCS_ProcessAlarmsAMP3_2] t WITH (NOLOCK) CROSS JOIN p
WHERE t.[TimeStamp] >= p.Hs AND t.[TimeStamp] < DATEADD(hour, 1, p.Hs) AND t.[Condition] <> '' AND t.[ActiveState] = 'ACTIVE' AND t.[AckRequired] = 'ACKREQD' AND ISNULL(t.[Priority], '') <> 'Logging' AND CASE WHEN LEFT(t.[Source], 5) = '27C10' THEN 0 WHEN LEFT(t.[Source], 5) = '27C30' THEN 1 WHEN LEFT(t.[Source], 5) = '27C50' THEN 2 WHEN LEFT(t.[Source], 5) = '27C60' THEN 3 WHEN LEFT(t.[Source], 5) = '27C70' THEN 4 WHEN LEFT(t.[Source], 5) = '27C80' THEN 5 WHEN LEFT(t.[Source], 5) = '27C90' THEN 6 WHEN LEFT(t.[Source], 5) IN ('27000','27100','27110','27120','27130','27140','27150','27210','27220','27900','279AC','279EA','279EE','279FF','279FS','279LA','279PF','279PG','279PH','279PJ','279WJ') THEN 7 WHEN LEFT(t.[Source], 5) IN ('27C00','27CFF','27CPD','27SCA') THEN 8 ELSE 9 END = TRY_CAST(NULLIF('@Area', '') AS int)
GROUP BY LEFT(t.[Source], 5)
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
setting.Title: @AreaName - @HourStart: activations per area code

setting.Query:
WITH p AS (SELECT TRY_CONVERT(datetime, NULLIF('@HourStart', ''), 120) AS Hs)
SELECT CONVERT(char(8), t.[TimeStamp], 108) AS [Time], t.[Source] AS Tag, t.[Condition] AS Condition, LEFT(t.[Source], 5) AS Area_code, t.[Priority] AS Priority, t.[Description] AS Description
FROM dbo.[_MaadenAMP3_DCS_ProcessAlarmsAMP3_2] t WITH (NOLOCK) CROSS JOIN p
WHERE t.[TimeStamp] >= p.Hs AND t.[TimeStamp] < DATEADD(hour, 1, p.Hs) AND t.[Condition] <> '' AND t.[ActiveState] = 'ACTIVE' AND t.[AckRequired] = 'ACKREQD' AND ISNULL(t.[Priority], '') <> 'Logging' AND CASE WHEN LEFT(t.[Source], 5) = '27C10' THEN 0 WHEN LEFT(t.[Source], 5) = '27C30' THEN 1 WHEN LEFT(t.[Source], 5) = '27C50' THEN 2 WHEN LEFT(t.[Source], 5) = '27C60' THEN 3 WHEN LEFT(t.[Source], 5) = '27C70' THEN 4 WHEN LEFT(t.[Source], 5) = '27C80' THEN 5 WHEN LEFT(t.[Source], 5) = '27C90' THEN 6 WHEN LEFT(t.[Source], 5) IN ('27000','27100','27110','27120','27130','27140','27150','27210','27220','27900','279AC','279EA','279EE','279FF','279FS','279LA','279PF','279PG','279PH','279PJ','279WJ') THEN 7 WHEN LEFT(t.[Source], 5) IN ('27C00','27CFF','27CPD','27SCA') THEN 8 ELSE 9 END = TRY_CAST(NULLIF('@Area', '') AS int)
ORDER BY t.[TimeStamp], t.[ID]
